source_caption:
🎬 Raising Hope (2010–2014)

Raising Hope follows Jimmy Chance, a young man living with his eccentric working-class family whose life changes unexpectedly when he becomes a single father to a baby girl named Hope. With little money, no parenting experience, and an uncertain future, Jimmy must learn how to raise his daughter while still figuring out his own life. Fortunately, he has help from his parents, Virginia and Burt, who became parents at a young age themselves and often offer advice that is as questionable as it is hilarious. Also living in their chaotic household is Jimmy’s unpredictable great-grandmother, Maw Maw, whose unusual behavior creates some of the show’s funniest moments. As Jimmy struggles to balance fatherhood, work, friendships, and romance, the Chance family faces countless embarrassing situations, misunderstandings, and unexpected challenges. From disastrous family celebrations and unusual parenting methods to awkward romantic encounters and heartfelt sacrifices, their everyday lives are anything but ordinary. Despite their financial struggles and frequent mistakes, Jimmy and his family remain determined to give Hope a happy childhood filled with love and support. Along the way, Jimmy discovers that becoming a good parent is less about having everything figured out and more about showing up for the people who depend on you. Combining outrageous comedy, lovable characters, heartfelt moments, and unconventional family dynamics, the series celebrates parenthood, second chances, personal growth, and the importance of family.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Greg Garcia

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Raising Hope is an American television sitcom created by Greg Garcia that aired on Fox from September 21, 2010, to April 4, 2014. Following its first season, the show received two nominations at the 63rd Primetime Emmy Awards. Martha Plimpton was nominated for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series, and Cloris Leachman was nominated for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series. Plimpton also won the 2011 Satellite Award for Best Actress in a Comedy Series. The fourth season premiered Friday, November 15, 2013, at 9:00 pm Eastern/8:00 pm Central with back-to-back episodes.
